messages:
maria: Quick sync — final pre-serve checklist for mercury-7b v1. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/weights/mercury-7b/v1/ (see manifest). Need: config lint, tokenizer quirks documented, golden-set run for structured tool-calls, and a short rollback plan. Can people ack who will take which?

devin: Ack. I can run config-lint + CI tidy. Which files to validate? serving.yaml, runtime.conf, and model.meta?

prashant: Confirm weights path: s3://redwood-prod/weights/mercury-7b/v1/fp16/*.bin — checksum sha256: d4c3b2a1... (uploaded to infra ticket). Also FYI tokenizer oddity: this model's tokenizer uses a fused sentinel token `<|toolcall|>` mapped to id 50223; old python-tokenizer v0.9 splits it into two tokens.

olga: Noted. I saw the same when running local sample. Workaround is to upgrade tokenizer to v0.10.0-rc1 or apply a small merge in tokenizer mapping (`merge_pairs: [["<|toolcall|>", 50223]]`).

maria: Good. Devin — please run lint and post results. Prashant/Olga — can you run golden-eval for the tool-calling suite (structured outputs) and paste the failures if any? Use `eval-run --gold gold_toolcalls.json --model mercury-7b:v1 --schema structured-v2`.

devin: Running config-lint now: `tools/config-lint --path serving.yaml --schema v2`

infra-bot: CI started for thread 2054321111: linting serving.yaml, runtime.conf, model.meta.

devin: Lint result: serving.yaml had two issues: port was quoted string (fixed in PR 4892), and `max_batch_size` missing (set to 8). Pushed commit 7a1d8f1. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4892

prashant: Golden-eval started locally. First pass shows 3 regressions out of 45 tests: toolcall-03 (args serialized as string not array), structured-schema-07 (missing `confidence` field in some outputs), and tool-routing-01 intermittent timeout to tools-gateway.

olga: For toolcall-03 I reproduced: tokenizer split changed the serialization boundary, so the tool args ended up as a single string in the JSON payload. Quick mitigation: in the serve wrapper coerce `args` to list if type==string. I'll draft a >1-line patch:
```
# serve middleware
if isinstance(payload.get('args'), str):
    payload['args'] = [payload['args']]
```

maria: Middleware acceptable short-term but we should fix token mapping upstream. Prashant — can you try pinning to tokenizer v0.10.0-rc1 in the model package and re-run golden?

prashant: Yup. Pinning and re-running. Also rechecked weights checksum, matches.

karen: FYI scheduling canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC if we get green in the quick gold run. I'll monitor latency + toolcall error_rate and have rollback window 30m. Thresholds: latency P95 < 180ms, toolcall error_rate < 1%.

devin: PR for lint merged, CI green for config. CI artifacts: serving.yaml (validated), runtime.conf (validated).

prashant: After pin to v0.10.0-rc1, golden-eval re-run: 44/45 pass — only failing test is structured-schema-07 (missing `confidence` in 2 samples). Root cause: model sometimes emits `confidence` as null for ambiguous tool outputs.

olga: I'll add a schema guard to the output post-process to populate `confidence` with 0.0 when null, plus add a logging metric so we can track frequency. Patch ready, pushing in 10m.

infra-bot: Golden-eval job complete (run-id: ge-2054321111): 44/45 pass. Failures: structured-schema-07 (missing confidence x2).

maria: Great progress. Action items: olga to push guardrail for confidence (PR 4920), prashant to run full smoke with the guardrail, devin to cut canary config (ports, burst settings), karen to schedule monitoring. If all green, proceed with canary 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

olga: PR 4920 opened with post-process guardrail + metric `gold.confidence_missing`. Will re-run golden once merged.

prashant: I'll re-run golden as soon as PR merges and ping here. Expect results in ~12m.

infra-bot: Note: please add rollback tag `canary:mercury-7b:v1` in the rollout plan.

maria: Thanks everyone — ping here when golden is green and include the final smoke checklist (weights checksum, token version, PRs, monitoring links). :thumbsup:
